title: Auto Farm, OP Farm, Instant Chest, ZD Hub
features:
ZD Hub - Lineage Piece
A complete, optimized script for Lineage Piece featuring a modern Fluent UI interface compatible with both PC and Mobile, equipped with a custom toggle button and an automatic configuration save system.
Key Features
 * Auto Farm Level: Automatically manages progression from level 1 to max level, accepting and renewing quests autonomously.
 * Auto Farm Mob & OP Farming: Custom selection of targeted monsters, an OP Farm mode (recommended above level 4000), and an enemy grouping feature (Bring Mobs).
 * Combat & Skills: Multi-weapon support, automatic basic attack execution (Auto M1), and automated skill triggering (Z, X, C, V, A, B, F).
 * Stats Management: Automatic point allocation (Strength, Defense, Weapon, Power) based on configured amounts.
 * Shop & Items: Automatic purchasing of random fruits and specific weapons (Katana, Dual Katana, Gryphon).
 * Utilities & Islands: Rapid collection of all map chests (ultra-fast 1-click mode), island-to-island teleportation, and map cleanup options to boost performance.
How to Use
Copy the source code or use your preferred injector with the script's loadstring to launch the hub interface in-game.
